rows.name: Ram Ratna Wires Limited
rows.shareholdingPatternNotes: As reported in the earlier quarter, please note that subsequent to the Scheme of Amalgamation effecting merger of Ram Ratna Research and Holdings Private Limited (RRRHPL) and Jag-Bid Finvest Private Limited (JBFPL) into Hemlata Home Solutions Private Limited (HHSPL), HHSPL was converted into a Limited Liability Partnership under the name Hemlata Home Solutions LLP (HHS LLP) with effect from 27 January 2026. However, the name of HHSPL continues to appear as a Promoter Group member in the beneficial position (BENPOS) data as of 30 June 2026, as the process of updating the name to HHS LLP in one of its demat account (relating to JBFPL) is still ongoing. HHSPL name is therefore reflected in the shareholding pattern pursuant to the BENPOS data, pending its name change in the depository system. Further, please note that Makewise Ventures LLP has been removed from the Promoter Group category, as the company has been struck off by the Registrar of Companies.

rows.name: Ram Ratna Wires Limited
rows.remarksWeb: Please note that, pursuant to a Scheme of Amalgamation effective 1 October 2025, Ram Ratna Research and Holdings Private Limited (RRRHPL) and Jag-Bid Finvest Private Limited (JBFPL) were merged into Hemlata Home Solutions Private Limited (HHSPL), all being part of the Promoter Group entities. As a result, the shareholding of RRRHPL and JBFPL in the Company were transferred to and held by HHSPL. The name change in respective demat accounts of RRRHPL and JBFPL to HHSPL was completed in quarter ended March, 2026 pursuant to the said Scheme of Amalgamation, therefore their names have been removed from the Promoter Group. Subsequently, HHSPL was converted into a Limited Liability Partnership under the name Hemlata Home Solutions LLP (HHS LLP) with effect from 27 January 2026. However, the name HHSPL continues to appear as a Promoter Group member in the beneficial position (BENPOS) data as of 31 March 2026, as the process of updating the name in its demat account is still ongoing. HHSPL name is therefore reflected in the shareholding pattern pursuant to the BENPOS data, pending its name change in the depository system. The Company has received declarations from the Significant Beneficial Owners confirming that their indirect holding through HHS LLP, along with their direct shareholding, exceeds 10% of the Companys paid-up share capital. Accordingly, in the SBO details provided in this shareholding pattern, the name HHS LLP (formerly HHSPL) has been disclosed even though the BENPOS data as of 31 March 2026 still reflects the name HHSPL.

rows.name: Ram Ratna Wires Limited
rows.remarksWeb: Please note the following:  1. The Finance and Allotment Committee of the Company, at their meeting held on Thursday, November 27, 2025, considered and approved the allotment of 48,000 (Forty-Eight Thousand) equity shares having face value of Rs. 5/- (Rupees Five) each fully paid up pursuant to the exercise of stock options under the RRWL Employee Stock Option Plan 2023. Consequent to the said allotment, the paid up equity share capital of the Company increased from 4,66,26,536 equity shares to 4,66,74,536 equity shares.  2. The Finance and Allotment Committee of the Company, at their meeting held on Monday, December 29, 2025, considered and approved the allotment of 4,66,74,536 Bonus Equity Shares in the ratio of 1:1, to the Members of the Company, holding equity shares on the Record Date i.e. Friday, December 26, 2025. Accordingly, the total issued and paid up equity shares of the Company increased from 4,66,74,536 equity shares to 9,33,49,072 equity shares and the paid-up share capital of the Company increased from Rs. 23,33,72,680 to Rs. 46,67,45,360.   3. Further, please note that Ram Ratna Research and Holdings Private Limited (RRRHPL) and Jag-Bid Finvest Private Limited (JBFPL) have been merged with Hemlata Home Solutions Private Limited (HHSPL)  pursuant to a Scheme of Amalgamation which became effective from October 1, 2025. All the abovementioned entities, viz., RRRHPL, JBFPL and HHSPL, belong to the Promoter Group and are reflected in the shareholding pattern under para A(1)(d). Pursuant to the said Scheme of Amalgamation and also as intimated by the concerned parties vide the intimations filed in the month of October 2025 under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, the respective shareholding of RRRHPL and JBFPL in Ram Ratna Wires Limited is now held by HHSPL, the transferee company.  However, the process relating to updation of name in the demat accounts of RRRHPL and JBFPL is currently in progress, due to which the names of RRRHPL and JBFPL continue to appear in the beneficial position (BENPOS) obtained from the Depositories as on December 31, 2025. Accordingly, the Shareholding Pattern has been prepared and reported based on the BENPOS data available as of December 31, 2025, reflecting the separate names as appearing therein.
